LOW_BasiliskGate_Sergeant
Manip Seyama is a human ranger and a sergeant of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in Lower City in Act Three.
“
Your tools were stolen, right? No - you were mugged! Wait, I'm mixing you up with another citizen.
„
— Seyama

Involvement

Seyama is stationed inside the Basilisk Gate Barracks office. She has been tasked with sorting out crime complaints, but is seemingly overwhelmed by the amount of them. If spoken to, she cannot compose her thoughts, taking the player character as one of the bidders.

One of the complainants waiting outside,  Thatmatt Oakhide, occasionally walks inside the office to update on his case. Seyama is trying to placate him while maintaining some formality all the while.

Seyama's reactions to the player character differ a bit if they have successfully detected a charm put on  Blaze Liara Portyr while talking to her and  Lora Bergauz upon taking up the quest ⁠Save Vanra.

Idle banter

 Thatmatt Oakhide will occasionally go to Seyama Manip Seyama to check on the status of his complaint:

  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Oi - I've been mugged. I'm here about my case?
  • Manip Seyama
    We're dealing with an increased number of complaints, sir - please wait your turn.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Right. I'll be outside.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Portyr herself said she was investigating my case?
  • Manip Seyama
    Blaze Portyr will get to you when she gets to you.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    I'm sure.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    My wife and I have been waiting half the day - are you lot gonna help us or not?
  • Manip Seyama
    Take that tone with me again, and you'll see no one. You'll be called when you're called.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Damned Fist...
